'''Luxa's disruptor''' was a [[Disruptor pistol/Legends|disruptor pistol]] that was believed to have belonged to [[Luxa]], a [[Zeltron/Legends|Zeltron]] [[Gender/Legends|female]], who worked for the [[Exchange|The Exchange]] on [[Citadel Station]] over [[Telos IV]].

==Behind the scenes==
In the game, it isn't possible to find or buy this disruptor pistol.
